methods.label: Continue the sequence in order
methods.explanation:
Each new number uses the three immediately preceding numbers, so calculate the terms in order. Starting with \(1,2,3,6\), we get
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{5th: }&2+3+6=11,\\
\text{6th: }&3+6+11=20,\\
\text{7th: }&6+11+20=37,\\
\text{8th: }&11+20+37=68.
\end{aligned}
\]
The eighth number is \(\boxed{68}\), choice D.
